title: Chandra ko shraap kaise bana Somnath?
hooks: Chandra ne Daksh ki 27 betiyon se byah kiya, par dil sirf Rohini pe aaya
Kyun ghat ta badhta hai chandrama har maheene
Shraap mila Chand ko aur Shiv ne bana diya Somnath
hook_why: Subject-first opening with 'Chandra' as first word; immediate conflict (27 wives, one favorite) creates open loop; visual of favoritism is instantly graspable; colloquial 'dil sirf Rohini pe aaya' sounds like a friend talking
metaphor: Moon's waxing and waning as a living metaphor for curse turning into divine rhythm — each phase a reminder that grace can restructure punishment into cosmic order

cast.Chandra: fair luminous deity in white silk, crescent moon on forehead, calm expression, traditional gold ornaments, soft glow around form
cast.Daksha: elderly sage-king with long white beard, rudraksha mala, angry but regal posture, saffron dhoti, raised hand in curse gesture
cast.Shiva: serene yogi with matted locks tied up, crescent moon on crown, third eye closed, rudraksha beads, tiger skin draped, damru at side, deep meditative gaze
cast.Rohini: beautiful woman in red bridal silk, heavy gold jewelry, standing slightly apart from 26 other wives in white, radiant but modest

caption:
Chandra ne 27 patniyan chhodi, sirf Rohini chahi — Daksh ne shraap de diya. Shiv ne apne maath pe chand laga ke shraap ko ashirwad bana diya. Yeh hai Somnath ki kahani. 🌙

Tumhari zindagi mein kaunsa dard badal ke roshni bana? Comment karo.

claims.claim: Chandra (Moon) married 27 daughters of Daksha Prajapati
Chandra favored Rohini over the other 26 wives
claims.basis: Shiva Purana, Kotirudra Samhita; also in Bhagavata Purana 6.18

claims.claim: Daksha cursed Chandra to lose his brightness (wane)
Chandra performed penance at Prabhas Patan and worshipped a Shivling
Shiva blessed Chandra to wax and wane monthly, establishing Somnath Jyotirlinga

claims.claim: Somnath is the first of the 12 Jyotirlingas
